join_order.notes: Pre-filter sub, build adsh_code→(sic,cik) lookup array indexed by adsh_code for O(1) access during num scan
Use pre-built tag_pk hash index; check abstract==:abstract_eq, read tlabel_code
Use pre-built pre_join hash multimap index; for each matching pre row check stmt==:stmt_eq

filters.notes: Checked via bitset on adsh_code; most selective filter on num rows
Checked on each pre row returned by pre_join index

scan_order_within_num: 1. Check adsh_code in valid_sub_bitset (most selective ~4.1%, eliminates 96% of rows early)
4. Lookup tag_pk index → check abstract, read tlabel_code
5. Lookup pre_join index → for each pre_row check stmt, accumulate
6. Read value, accumulate into group aggregation

prefilter_sub.description: Scan sub.sic, find rows where sic BETWEEN :sic_lower AND :sic_upper, build two structures

outputs.valid_adsh_bitset: bitset indexed by adsh_code for fast membership test during num scan
outputs.sub_info_array: flat array indexed by adsh_code → struct{int16_t sic, int32_t cik} for qualifying subs only (use sub_adsh_lookup index to map adsh_code→sub_row)

prefilter_sub.approach: Iterate all 86,135 sub rows, check sic range, for qualifying rows: use row_id to read adsh_code from sub/adsh.bin, set bit in bitset, store sic+cik in info array

data_structures.valid_sub_bitset: bitset(max_adsh_code + 1) — for O(1) membership check; max_adsh_code ≤ 250,000 → ~31KB
data_structures.sub_info_array: flat_array[max_adsh_code + 1] of {sic: int16_t, cik: int32_t} — direct indexed; ~1.5MB
data_structures.pre_join_index: pre-built hash multimap (loaded from indexes/pre_join.idx + pre_join_rowids.idx)
data_structures.aggregation: compact_hash_map keyed by (sic:int16_t, tlabel_code:uint32_t, stmt_code:uint8_t) → {sum_value:double, count:uint64_t, cik_set:small_hash_set<int32_t>}
data_structures.thread_local_agg: per-thread compact_hash_map (same schema), merged after parallel scan

parallelism.notes: Each thread scans a morsel of num rows, performs all chained lookups and accumulates into thread-local agg map. Final sequential merge combines all maps.

indexes.purpose: map adsh_code to sub row_id during prefilter phase
lookup tag row by (tag_code, version_code) for abstract filter and tlabel retrieval
lookup pre rows by (adsh_code, tag_code, version_code) for stmt filter
row ID array for pre_join multimap results

mmap_notes: Use mmap without MAP_POPULATE; declare mmap resources before RAII timer scope to exclude munmap TLB shootdown cost from timing

aggregation.group_key_notes: stmt is constant after filter but still included for correctness with parameterized queries

aggregates.count_value: COUNT(n.value) as uint64_t — for computing AVG = sum_value / count_value
aggregates.distinct_cik: small unordered_set<int32_t> per group for COUNT(DISTINCT s.cik)
